text: This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 345 Finchdene Square. The application indicates the reason for removal is that the tree is to facilitate enlargement of the existing parking lot. The subject tree is a white spruce (Picea glauca), measuring 40 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree, as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, referred Item SC29.10 to the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, Council having been advised that the application has been withdrawn.
